TASWIRA · UNREVIEWED DRAFT

Before the borders.
The land moved.

A 23-second history pilot in the green-and-gold Taswira style. Moving continents, camera flights, rising markers and ironworking effects. 1080p, 60 fps. Silent, with captions and credits.

This viewing copy is compressed. Modern continental outlines are moved by the plate model; they are not ancient coastlines. Regional geography is approximate. Historical review and source-specific reuse checks remain necessary before publication.
